messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — seeing repeated memory spikes + tail latency on long-context runs (8k+). Suspect KV-share across merged batches causing HOL stall and page thrash.

devon: Logs? profile?

maria: Pasting snippet from perf-runner:
```text
seq=8192 ctx=1k..8k qps=150
kv_cache_pages_allocated=124M
page_faults/sec=320
tail_p95_tok_latency=280ms -> 580ms after merge
```

ryan: Hmm. Are we merging batches that have KV offsets that cross page boundaries? That could cause eviction churn.

alex: Repro steps?

maria: Small repro: run continuous-batcher with mix of short(64) & long(8192) -> merge window 30ms -> observe head-of-line when long ctx hits AOT evict. Command:
```
./bin/runner --mix short:80,long:20 --merge-ms 30 --kv-page-size 4M
```

devon: Interesting. Kernel selection may be switching to large-seq kernels for the long batch, which increases KV footprint per worker and triggers global pager. Might need size-aware kernel selection.

perf-bot: [perf-regression] 1854325600 -> overall p95 increased 1.9x on commit abc123 (kv_merge: enable).

ryan: Maybe continuous-batcher should avoid merging across large-kv consumers. Batching heuristic: only merge if expected KV delta < page_threshold.

maria: Proposed quick patch: compute estimated_kv_pages(batch) = sum(ceil(kv_bytes/4M)) and only merge if combined_pages - max(individual_pages) < 4.

alex: Also consider prefetching KV ranges for merged batch to avoid synchronous page faults. Could be a one-time async touch.

devon: Agreed. Also add eviction scorer that prefers compacting fragments instead of full page reclamation under low pressure.

ryan: Can we instrument to emit kv_page_fault_{count,src} and batch_merge_id in traces? Need to correlate.

maria: I'll add counters + a mini-tracer span. Also will run A/B with merge-ms 0 vs 30 to confirm.

alex: If prefetch, ensure we don't blow memory. Use capped prefetch pages = min(8, combined_pages).

maria: Will push draft PR with tests and a microbenchmark. WIP branch: feat/kv-merge-safety.

devon: If perf-bot confirms rollback-risk, we might gate merge on "dedicated" tier only.

ryan: For long-term: tuning kernel selection to prioritize KV locality for continuous batches. Maybe prefer GPU kernel that keeps KV coalesced.

maria: Thanks. I'll post results in ~2 hours.

perf-bot: Deployed benchmark cluster with instrumentation. run id=1854325701.
